scope: Legacy BOUND native compiler interfaces, exact source projection, protected-state completion and full-width returned-value preservation

reference.qualified_host: Intel Core i9-13900H; CPU 2 P core, CPU 12 E core, CPUID.1A core types 0x40/0x20
reference.interpretation: The observed CPU compares signed inclusive lower <= index <= upper. It does not add the element size to the upper bound. The upper field is accessed only after the lower comparison succeeds.

contract.protected: Code16/code32, independently selected address16/address32, word/dword index and bounds, CPL0-3, segmented ordinary RAM under legacy paging/PAE. Each field offset wraps independently; bytes within a field do not wrap past its segment limit.
contract.faults: Lower operand access precedes signed comparison; a lower failure raises #BR without touching the upper field. #BR/#GP/#SS/#PF/#AC and original fault EIP/RF follow the existing ordered executor. Original guest #BR/#PF handlers repair state and IRET before retry.
contract.mpx: CPL and OSXSAVE are rebound from the current machine. Enabled #BR clears BNDSTATUS before attempted IDT delivery, even if delivery fails. Unknown enable state and explicitly active transactions refuse before fetch; an active transaction is refused even when MPX is disabled.
contract.compiler: LLVM bound16/bound32 pointer and address32 interfaces plus four Clang builtins lower to native BOUND in code16/i386. Address controls and long-mode use are rejected. Calls have conservative memory effects and no result; repeated or unused checks remain observable.
contract.source: Low/Med retain index, normalized eight-byte segment offset, constant address width and segment. HighC and LLVMC share a renderer requiring a concrete X86 target and the exact memory-effect contract. The pinned SDK retains one exact volatile GNU assembly alternative.
contract.returned_value: A complete propagated parameter, temporary, constant or other-register value precedes later physical return-register read views. HighC and LLVM apply this to integer/pointer returns; declared source types do not authorize truncating a full returned value.
contract.decoder: Capstone BOUND index and bounds memory operands are read-only, with no invented register or EFLAGS writes. Strict lifting checks raw bytes against the corrected operand details.

final_test_only_integration.replaces: The earlier SysVCallContractTests executions in the integration matrix
final_test_only_integration.reason: Dev 359e9aad63 changes only this test harness and documentation: direct typed calls replace incompatible function-pointer calls, and UBSan is nonrecoverable. Production sources are unchanged; both 43-test suites were rebuilt and rerun.

qualification.integration_limits: The complete source suites, 623 shared return/ABI/control-flow tests per SDK, both core BOUND matrices and all source exports were rerun after the final review fixes and merge of dev 4d23cad0da. The full 422-test paging snapshots predate the transaction admission guard; the final matrix/unit tests cover that guard. No default-acceleration or physical MPX/LA57 claim is made.

diagnostics: Before the decoder fix, all 224 operand-access cases failed because Capstone described a BOUND register output.
The original source witness caught word BOUND changing returned 0x0000ffff into 0xffffffff. MedIR retained the full input; HighC selected a later AX read.

A separate x64 declared integer/pointer fixture reproduced the same truncation after mov [rsi],ax. The shared returned-value rule now retains the complete propagated other-register value; both C routes compile and execute at O0/O2.
The active-transaction regression failed with MPX disabled before the explicit pre-fetch refusal.
Changed argmem-only/inaccessible-memory-only LLVM call effects were incorrectly accepted before requiring the exact conservative memory effects.

Fixture repairs: native LLVM rejects nonvoid/vararg inline-asm construction before rendering; those malformed forms are tested through native declarations. Code16 address carriers may use SI, not only DI. Read-only DS cannot supply a normal C frame return, so those cases compare the instruction boundary.
Wrong-index and truncated-return negative controls are rejected while an intact BOUND remains present.

Superseded 72-case source reports, early protected fixture failures, stale 515-test r6 control-flow run and interrupted r6 pre-review source run are preserved locally and excluded from final qualification.
remaining_boundaries: NeverC still has no i386 frontend. Its committed witnesses qualify the full LLVM/Clang toolchain and actual NeverD exports, not a NeverC BOUND builtin in long mode.
This host has no physical MPX or LA57 qualification. MPX status is covered by software-owner tests; the broad paging LA57 case skips explicitly.
These compiler source witnesses do not establish original-state execution for arbitrary generated C, RTM/HLE completion, async/device progress, or other original-state dispatchers.

General i386 source ABI, remaining scalar/vector/string completion, real/VM86, task/call gates, debug events, software SMM/SMI, SGX/AEX/EPCM, full CET/FRED and multicore/TLB/device state remain outside this BOUND batch.
